prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want specific contractor names & contact info I can look up now, or would you prefer guidance on how to find and vet reliable contractors in Joplin?

If you want names, I can search and return a short vetted list. If you want general help right away, here’s a concise, practical approach you can use to find a reliable local contractor and how to vet them.

Where to look (local sources)
- Google Maps / Google Reviews — shows recent customer feedback and photos.
- Better Business Bureau (BBB.org) — accreditation status and complaint history.
- Angi / HomeAdvisor /Thumbtack — lead sites with reviews and screening.
- Joplin Area Chamber of Commerce — local business referrals.
- Facebook community groups / Nextdoor — local neighbor referrals and before/after photos.
- Ask friends/neighbors who had similar work done — in-person references are best.

How to vet contractors (quick checklist)
1. License & insurance
   - Confirm they’re licensed where required and carry general liability and workers’ comp.
   - Get proof of insurance and verify with the insurer.
2. References & portfolio
   - Ask for 3 recent references (same type of project) and contact them.
   - View recent job-site photos or visit a current job (with permission).
3. Written estimate & scope
   - Get at least 2–3 detailed, written bids that list scope, materials, timeline, and cleanup.
4. Contract & payment terms
   - Signed contract with scope, payment schedule, change-order process, start/finish dates, warranty.
   - Avoid large upfront payments (customary is small deposit, progress payments).
5. Permits & inspections
   - Contractor should pull required permits and arrange inspections; verify with the City of Joplin building dept.
6. Timeline & communication
   - Confirm a realistic timeline and a single point of contact.
7. Red flags
   - Vague scope, demanding full payment up front, no written contract, poor or no references, lots of negative online reviews or unresolved BBB complaints.

Specific questions to ask a contractor
- How long have you been in business in Joplin?
- Can you provide three local references for this type of work?
- Will you pull necessary permits and handle inspections?
- What is the projected start date and completion date?
- What warranties do you offer on labor and materials?
- Who will be on site each day and how will changes be handled?

Local civic/official checks
- Contact Joplin Building Division / City of Joplin to confirm permit requirements and ask if they maintain a list of frequently-used contractors or common complaints.
- Check BBB and local Chamber of Commerce membership.

If you want, I can now:
- Look up and return a short list (3–5) of top-rated Joplin remodel/repair contractors with ratings, websites, and phone numbers; or
- Help you draft an email template to request bids and references from contractors.

Tell me which you prefer and a few details about your project (kitchen, bathroom, whole-house remodel, roof, plumbing/electrical repair, approximate budget, timeline) and I’ll proceed.
